title: Hearty Dense Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring lamb, brie, and a blend of spices, cooked in a single pot with a dense and winey sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven, cooking at 300 degrees for 2.5 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the brie cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot over rice or couscous.
